approaches.title: Prefix Sum with Minimum Prefix Tracking
approaches.summary: Tracks the running prefix sum and the smallest prefix seen so far. The maximum subarray sum is the largest difference between the current prefix and a prior minimum prefix.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Computes the maximum subarray sum using running prefix sums and the minimum prefix encountered so far.

approaches.title: Kadane's Algorithm
approaches.summary: Tracks the best subarray sum ending at the current position and the best sum seen globally. Each element either extends the current subarray or starts a new one.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces prefix-minimum tracking with Kadane's recurrence, maintaining the best ending-at-current sum and global maximum.
